chunks: Say: 'Our Lord will gather us together and judge between us equitably, for He is the Judge all-knowing.'
ai.seo_question: How does Allah judge between people according to Surah Saba?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Saba, this verse reassures the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) that Allah, as Al-Fattah (The Opener), will ultimately resolve the disputes between the believers and the disbelievers through divine truth. Shia scholarship often highlights 'Al-Fattah' not only as the One who opens the gates of judgment but also as the One who opens the hearts to guidance, linking this attribute to the eventual victory of the Ahl al-Bayt. The mention of 'Al-Alim' underscores that this final separation is based on comprehensive knowledge of all hidden intentions and actions.
